verdict.rationale: Bento claims every release is scored against production history offline, in CI, and on live traffic, and it captures full production traces with tagging, signals, and issue grouping. That covers the offline-eval-against-production half of the story. However, no evidence shows an explicit dataset curation workflow, such as selecting, labeling, or versioning trace subsets into named datasets. Missing for 10: documented dataset creation and curation from traces, details on how offline eval runs are configured and scored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
